## Policies

### Peer Review

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Type** | Masked (double-anonymized) review is OPTIONAL, not mandatory/default — authors select a masked article type at submission if they want it. Per APA XGE submission guidelines (apa.org/pubs/journals/xge/submit): "Masked reviews are optional. If you want a masked review, please select one of the masked article types upon submission." (verified 2026-07-20) |
| **Transferable / Cascade?** | *(pending — APA has cross-journal transfer for some titles)* |
| **Reviewer reports published?** | No (per APA default) |

| **Reviewer recommendations** | *(pending)* |
### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | No (follows APA publisher default) |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | No outright prohibition — conditional/disclosure-based (permitted provided authors disclose use; not a full ban) |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 4 |
| **Summary** | Follows APA publisher AI policy: authors must disclose use of generative AI tools (ChatGPT, etc.) for generating ideas/content/analysis/code in the Methods/Introduction; purely light-touch AI-assisted copyediting/proofreading only needs an author-note mention, not body-text disclosure. AI cannot satisfy authorship criteria. Editors and reviewers are explicitly prohibited from inputting submitted manuscripts into AI tools (confidentiality). |
| **Source URL** | https://www.apa.org/pubs/journals/policies/ |

## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from publisher-disclosed practices (apa.org/pubs/journals/xge) and community-aggregator evidence (scirev.org, mindingthebrain.blogspot.com acceptance rates) gathered 2026-05. ### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | Medium-High — international general-experimental authorship |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | Medium-High — diversity in cognitive samples and topics published |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | General experimental psychology — neural/behavioral (659 articles), memory processes (504), child/animal learning (454), decision-making (444), moral/emotional judgment (325), social/intergroup (314), visual perception (293) per OpenAlex |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **general experimental psychology contribution with broad interest beyond narrow subfield**. Methodological rigor + general interest required. Long-form articles preferred over brief reports.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: 2013 raw rejection rate 83% (community evidence: mindingthebrain.blogspot.com 2026-05). Brief reports rejected without review at higher rate than longer articles. Desk reject can take 4+ weeks due to high submission volume; effective acceptance rate is higher than raw due to R&R-then-accept paths.

| Qualitative interviews | 1 | Rare |
| Autoethnography | 0 | Outside scope |

| Meta-analysis | 4 | 18 article(s) found (OpenAlex keyword search, 2021-2026, 1510 total in window; 1.2%) — shows the journal does publish this, but uncommonly — the high rating is a family-level estimate that this output rate does not by itself support |

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

Reviewers drawn primarily from the general experimental psychology community — APA Division 3 (Experimental Psychology) faculty and senior researchers across memory, attention, decision-making, language, perception, and learning. Common reviewer demands: "Generalization beyond your paradigm?", "Theoretical contribution?", "Methodological rigor?". Long-form preference reflects valuing multi-study programmatic work over brief reports.

### AI-Research Notes (supplementary AI research, 2026-07-13)

> Added as a **supplementary, independent research pass** — it does NOT overwrite or supersede the Tier assessment above. Treat conflicts as a signal to re-verify, not as an automatic correction. Overall `signal_quality` for this pass: **2/5**.

**AI-research finding (policy):** 此為 APA 出版社層級（非本刊獨有）政策：AI 不得列為作者；作者若用生成式 AI 產生想法/內容/分析/程式碼等，須在方法或引言段落揭露並引註；純粹的『延伸式 AI 校對潤稿』僅需在 author note 註明，不強制正文揭露；編輯與審稿人被明文禁止將投稿內容輸入 AI 工具（保密考量）。未見 XGE 期刊頁對此政策做任何加嚴或放寬的期刊專屬聲明，故判定為 APA 通用政策沿用。

**AI-research finding (positioning — what the journal accepts now):** 官方 Aims & Scope：刊登廣泛心理學領域中，具跨社群（跨兩個以上心理學傳統次領域）興趣的實證與理論研究，主題可涉及社會歷程、發展歷程、精神疾病、神經科學或計算建模等；另收 Brief Reports（≤3000字），但此類稿件未經審查即拒稿比例較高，需展現高度結果穩健性且優先偏好跨多個心理學領域的影響力。

**AI-research finding (experiential):** 無具體接受率數字來源。APA 官方頁面提及 Brief Reports 類型『未經審查即拒稿的比例較高』，但未給出百分比，僅為定性描述，非可引用之接受率。 SciRev 彙整之量化評分：審稿報告品質 3.8/5.0；整體投稿處理流程評價 3.6/5.0（『流程良好』）；其中一筆評論將審稿難度評為 4.7/5.0（『非常困難』）。SciRev 摘要敘述審稿人『非常專業並提供大量有用建議』（此為 SciRev 平台對多筆評論的摘要措辭，樣本量小僅 6 筆，需謹慎採信）。

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Brief reports (rejected without review at higher rate than longer articles per community evidence 2026-05)
- 83% raw rejection rate (community evidence: mindingthebrain.blogspot.com 2026-05)
- Pure qualitative submissions
- Narrow-subfield work without broad-experimental-psychology framing
- Failure to disclose AI use per APA publisher policy

### Soft Tax

Moderate. Long-form preference adds writing time; desk-reject delay (4+ weeks due to high submission volume) means time-to-decision is non-trivial. For multi-study experimental authors, soft tax is low for the writing register; the structural constraint is the long review cycle.

### Best Suited For

- Multi-study experimental psychology programs (memory, decision-making, perception, learning)
- General-cognitive empirical work with broad-experimental-psychology interest
- Methodological rigor + theoretical contribution combinations
- Long-form experimental articles (multi-study programs)
- Authors comfortable with high submission volume + long review cycle
- Cross-cognitive integrative experimental work

### Not Recommended For

- Brief reports (consider Psychological Science Brief Reports, JEPLMC for memory-specific)
- Pure qualitative work
- Authors needing rapid decisions
- Narrow-subfield work without broad framing
- Single-case experimental designs

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Cognition](./cognition.md) | If recast as cognitive-experimental work; Elsevier; comparable long-form preference |
| 2 | [Journal of Cognitive Neuroscience](./journal-of-cognitive-neuroscience.md) | If the work has neural-measurement component; MIT Press |
| 3 | [Journal of Personality and Social Psychology](../psychology/journal-of-personality-and-social-psychology.md) | If the work is social-cognitive; APA flagship higher-tier |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a narrow-subfield experimental venue as "not specialized enough," JEP:General is often a better fit because: it explicitly values cross-cognitive general-experimental work; long-form multi-study programs are the journal's native format; and APA flagship reputation provides broad-experimental-psychology citation outlet.
